amused.instruction_restrained: Lightly amused, with a hint of a smile in the voice.
amused.instruction_strong: Clearly entertained and playful, almost chuckling through the delivery.
amused.text: You know what is funny? We spent years thinking the secret to growth was some clever marketing trick. Turns out the secret was answering the phone. Revolutionary, right? Sometimes the boring answer is the right one.

curious.instruction_restrained: Mildly curious tone, thoughtful, as if turning a question over in your mind.
curious.instruction_strong: Bright with curiosity, leaning in with real intrigue and wonder at the question.
curious.text: But what happens when intelligence becomes cheap? Not slightly cheaper, not a little more efficient. Actually cheap. What breaks first, and what becomes possible that was never possible before?

dramatic.instruction_restrained: A touch of drama, building slightly toward the end of the passage.
dramatic.instruction_strong: Full dramatic intensity. Theatrical pauses, rising tension, a sense of stakes.
dramatic.text: Then intelligence stops being the bottleneck. Everything downstream of that assumption, every process, every hierarchy, every moat, starts to crack. What comes next belongs to whoever moves first.

excited.instruction_restrained: Pleasantly enthusiastic and upbeat, but still natural, not over the top.
excited.instruction_strong: Bursting with excitement, high energy, animated delivery with expressive intonation.
excited.text: This is the part that gets me excited! We took a business that was losing forty percent of its after-hours calls and got them to near-perfect response in under two weeks. Two weeks! Seeing that happen for a real family business never gets old.

neutral.instruction_restrained: Calm, neutral, informative delivery at a natural conversational pace.
neutral.instruction_strong: Clear and confident delivery with quiet authority, steady and measured throughout.
neutral.text: Most home service businesses lose jobs they never knew about. A homeowner calls at seven in the evening, nobody picks up, and by morning they have already booked with whoever answered first.

reflective.instruction_strong: Deeply reflective and intimate, slow and contemplative, as if thinking aloud.
reflective.text: For most of computing history, intelligence was scarce. We built entire institutions around that scarcity. Schools, firms, agencies. All of them assumed the smartest person in the room was the bottleneck.

serious.instruction_strong: Grave and weighty, with deliberate emphasis on every word. Let the severity land.
serious.text: Let us be direct. If your business cannot respond to a customer in under five minutes, you are losing money every single day. Not maybe. Definitely. The data is unambiguous, and the fix is straightforward.

warm.instruction_restrained: Warm and friendly tone, like welcoming someone you already know.
warm.instruction_strong: Genuinely warm and inviting, with heartfelt friendliness coloring every phrase.
warm.text: Hey, welcome in. I am really glad you are here. I know this stuff can feel overwhelming, but we are going to keep it simple and honest. No hype, no pressure. Just real talk about what actually works.
